feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: One way to protect coral reefs? Bring back seabirds
entry.summary: Coral reefs are facing increasing threats around the globe. But on a remote Pacific island, scientists have found that reefs can get help from a surprising ally: seabirds.

entry.title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
entry.summary: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

entry.title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
entry.summary: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

entry.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
entry.summary: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.

entry.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home
entry.summary: Federal agents searched the Washington, D.C. home of Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., Monday morning. Omar criticized the search, calling it a weaponization of federal law enforcement.

entry.title: Legal analyst discusses search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with legal analyst Elliot Williams about the grounds for federal authorities' search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's home.

entry.title: Texans share how rising beef prices are affecting them this election season
entry.summary: The cost of living is one of the biggest issues in the upcoming midterm elections. NPR's A Martínez explores one slice of the economy in the key state of Texas: beef prices.

entry.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
entry.summary: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

entry.title: Actor Selma Blair removed from plane by police after altercation
entry.summary: Authorities say Blair was physically abusive and injured two flight attendants while traveling from Los Angeles to New York. A Blair representative said she had a medical emergency aboard the plane.

entry.title: Agents search Rep. Omar's D.C. home; DOJ says it's part of criminal investigation
entry.summary: The Justice Department says the search is part of an "ongoing federal investigation," while Omar calls it "an attempt to target political enemies."
